in_sanskrit.name: Basker
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Basker एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vasu’ meaning to dwell or inhabit, Basker is a Hindu name associated with the gods Vishnu and Ganesha. This name is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, while Ganesha is the remover of obstacles. Hence, Basker is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy.
